newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks retain firm tone in early morning.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks retain firm tone in early morning.

text.p: Tokyo stocks retained a firm tone in early Wednesday morning, continuing a recovery this week after sharp losses last week, brokers said.
They said the market was supported by gains in the U.S. stock market and the Nikkei futures overnight.
At 0013 GMT, the key 225-share Nikkei average was up 40.42 points or 0.19 percent at 20,998.50. Its December futures rose 80 points to 21,020.
"The Tokyo market is likely to be firm today, but we cannot hope for much gains and the Nikkei is likely to hover at around 21,000," said a broker at a second-tier securities house.
